verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents its own API keys for the REST API, SDK and CLI. Those keys carry team-scoped permissions, and team admins can revoke other members' keys, which gives coarse scoping and revocation. Nothing shows finer-grained, least-privilege scoping by resource or action. Missing for 10: per-resource/per-action permission scopes, read-only or role-limited keys, key expiry/TTL, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: If you are a team admin, you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.
API keys let you interact with Paperspace through the Core RESTful API, the Core JavaScript SDK, and Gradient command-line utility (CLI).
